overview.description: The NYLIM MacKay Securitized Income ETF (SECR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed, broad portfolio of securitized US fixed income securities. It seeks total return and current income. SECR was launched on May 31, 2024 and is issued by NYLIM.
